SELECT seq_transaction_tran_no.NEXTVAL FROM dual
INSERT INTO transaction ( tran_no, prod_no, buyer_id, payment_option, receiver_name, receiver_phone, demailaddr, dlvy_request, tran_status_code, order_data, dlvy_date ) VALUES ( #{tranNo}, #{purchaseProd.prodNo}, #{buyer.userId}, #{paymentOption}, #{receiverName}, #{receiverPhone}, #{divyAddr}, #{divyRequest}, NVL(#{tranCode, jdbcType=CHAR}, 'ODR'), -- 기본값 ODR SYSDATE, CASE WHEN #{divyDate} IS NULL OR #{divyDate} = '' THEN NULL ELSE TO_DATE(#{divyDate}, 'YYYYMMDD') END )
mapper.select: SELECT t.tran_no, t.prod_no, t.buyer_id, t.payment_option, t.receiver_name, t.receiver_phone, t.demailaddr, t.dlvy_request, t.tran_status_code, t.order_data, t.dlvy_date, p.prod_name, p.price, p.prod_detail, p.manufacture_day, p.image_file, u.user_name AS buyer_name, u.email AS buyer_email FROM transaction t JOIN product p ON p.prod_no = t.prod_no JOIN users u ON u.user_id = t.buyer_id WHERE t.tran_no = #{value}

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT inner_t.*, ROWNUM AS rnum FROM ( SELECT t.tran_no, t.prod_no, t.buyer_id, t.payment_option, t.receiver_name, t.receiver_phone, t.demailaddr, t.dlvy_request, t.tran_status_code, t.order_data, t.dlvy_date, p.prod_name, p.price, p.prod_detail, p.manufacture_day, p.image_file, u.user_name AS buyer_name, u.email AS buyer_email FROM transaction t JOIN product p ON p.prod_no = t.prod_no JOIN users u ON u.user_id = t.buyer_id WHERE t.buyer_id = #{buyerId} ORDER BY t.tran_no DESC ) inner_t WHERE ROWNUM <= #{endRow} ) WHERE rnum >= #{startRow}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM transaction WHERE buyer_id = #{buyerId}

SELECT t.tran_no, t.prod_no, t.buyer_id, t.payment_option, t.receiver_name, t.receiver_phone, t.demailaddr, t.dlvy_request, t.tran_status_code, t.order_data, t.dlvy_date, p.prod_name, p.price, p.prod_detail, p.manufacture_day, p.image_file, u.user_name AS buyer_name, u.email AS buyer_email FROM transaction t JOIN product p ON p.prod_no = t.prod_no JOIN users u ON u.user_id = t.buyer_id ORDER BY t.tran_no DESC
